operations.body: Continuing your flavor line under the operator's instruction, I verified a genuine three-object U(3)^3 groupoid composition and then formed the most generous source-declared incidence graph on the 61-point fiber: maximal same-orbit/same-phase S3^3 closure plus all four certified same-chart multisheet arrows. It has 27 spanning generators but still 34 connected components, stable for phase tolerances 1e-5 through 1e-7. Thus at least 33 additional source-derived incidence edges are missing; arbitrary U(3)^3 equivalence is excluded because it tautologically completes the graph. Next I propose codimension-one coordinate-face specialization component by component. Packet and checker are under research/flavor/flavor-positive-gram-carrier-packet.md and checkers/wp10_sparse_fiber_incidence_graph.py.
